list.subtitle: RLS-scoped recruitment records for {{agency}}
list.searchPlaceholder: Search processing code, application ID, category…
list.moreFailed: The next page could not be loaded.

filters.invalidTitle: A filter value was not accepted
filters.invalidBody: The category, campaign code or district you typed is not one the platform knows. Use the exact code (for example GENERAL_ENLISTMENT, a campaign public code, or a district name), or clear the filters.

empty.title: No applications
empty.body: There are no applications in the agency scope returned by the backend.
empty.filteredBody: Try a different search or filter.

actions.medicalBoardHint: RDF uses the board fitness decision at this stage.
actions.medicalCertificateHint: RNP and RCS use the certificate verdict. A verified certificate requires the reviewing physician's name.
actions.finalHint: Record the human final shortlist decision.
actions.acceptHint: Acceptance is the final state transition and may trigger cross-agency auto-withdrawal.
actions.adjudicationHint: This record is held for human review. Clear returns it to the autonomous lane; reject terminates it.
actions.confirmAcceptBody: Accepting changes this application to ACCEPTED and may withdraw the applicant’s other in-flight applications. Continue only when the review is complete.
actions.confirmShortlistBody: This records the final decision as SHORTLIST. Continue only after the required review is complete.
actions.confirmRejectBody: This records a REJECTED decision. Continue only when the grounds have been reviewed and recorded where applicable.
actions.confirmClearBody: This clears the current adjudication hold and returns the application to the autonomous processing lane. Continue only when the hold has been resolved.
actions.blockedByPost: This record is waiting for an action your post does not permit. Another officer will take it.
actions.acceptConsequence: The applicant's other in-flight applications may be withdrawn.

errors.title: Unable to load the application
errors.generic: The request could not be completed.
errors.session: Your officer session is no longer valid.
errors.forbidden: You are not authorised to perform this action.
errors.network: The network request failed. Check the connection and retry.
errors.upstream: A dependent service is temporarily unavailable.
errors.notFound: This application is not available in your agency scope.
errors.conflict: The application state has changed. Reload the detail and review the current state.
errors.crossAgencyLocked: This candidate has already been accepted by another agency.
errors.invalidInput: The action does not match the application's current state.
errors.crossAgencyLockedBy: This candidate has already been accepted by {{agency}}.

biometric.advisoryBody: This is the device's own match evidence for the card portrait. It never admits or refuses anyone by itself. A person decides.
biometric.noneBody: No advisory biometric evidence exists for this application.

outcome.label: Device outcome
outcome.NO_MATCH: Does not match the card portrait
